item.text: {"0":"Across all four datasets, replace each block's GELU feed-forward path with SwiGLU: two parallel d-to-2d projections, SiLU gating and a 2d-to-d output projection. Content-dependent gating may improve selective interactions after the successful feed-forward narrowing. Preserve bidirectional attention, pre-norm residuals, features, tied normalized embeddings, masking, appended-mask readout, loss and optimizer. Update predictor construction to match; retain one model per category.","1":"Across all four datasets, add a deterministic recency cue by scaling observed-item input vectors by 0.9 + 0.2*r, where r is chronological rank among nonpadding sequence positions, normalized from 0 to 1. Keep padding zero and mask-token scale at 1; compute ranks from positions only, without masked identities. This mild cue may emphasize recent context without the previously unsuccessful frequency scaling. Preserve embedding design, topology, readout, loss and optimizer; apply identical construction in prediction.","2":"Across all four datasets, jointly set learning rate to 7e-4, dropout to 0.3 and weight decay to 1e-5. Smaller updates and stronger regularization may complement normalized tied embeddings and the narrower feed-forward layers; this uses a less aggressive learning-rate reduction than the earlier modestly successful tuning trial. Keep width 64, two blocks, two heads, history length 128, batch size 128 and Adam. Preserve all formulas, seed 42, the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch.","3":"Across all four datasets, average full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy within each sampled sequence, then average those sequence losses across the batch. Equal sequence weighting may prevent longer histories, which contribute more masked positions, from dominating training on predominantly short histories. Use neither label smoothing nor extra final-position weighting, both of which previously regressed. Preserve masked-position sampling, features, embeddings, topology, scoring, appended-mask readout, optimizer and training settings; retain one model per category."}
